I'm pro-choice. I live in Ontario, Canada and not only are abortions legal, the majority of them are also funded by provincial healthcare, to my knowledge.

I went to a Catholic school, and even though they preached abstinence, they were still required to teach us about birth control and STDs in-depth.

I think that if you don't intend to get pregnant, then you should be using something to prevent that from happening. The pill, condoms, an IUD, whatever. I know if it was me, unfortunately I would have to get an abortion because of the medication I'm on (it causes fetal heart defects).
